Property Inspection & Advisory Report

Professional property inspection with detailed condition assessment, photographic record, cost-to-repair estimates, and a written advisory report.

Why You Need This Service

A property inspection serves multiple critical purposes:

  • Dispute Prevention: Document property condition when tenant moves in, so you have proof if they cause damage
  • Rent Justification: Show magistrate why a property is worth its rent
  • Maintenance Planning: Know what repairs are urgent vs. can wait
  • Insurance Claims: Have documented evidence of condition and damage
  • Property Valuation: Support asking price if you sell
  • Tenant Accountability: Formal inspection record holds tenants accountable for damage

This is evidence you'll be glad to have if anything goes wrong.

What's Included

  • Site Visit: We visit the property and inspect all areas
  • Condition Assessment: Detailed notes on structure, electrical, plumbing, finish, appliances
  • Photographic Record: 20–40 high-quality photos documenting condition
  • Repair Estimates: Cost estimates for needed repairs and maintenance
  • Priority Assessment: Which repairs are urgent, which can wait
  • Written Report: Professional report with findings and recommendations

Uses of This Report

  • Compare move-in condition vs. move-out (document tenant damage)
  • Support rent level in Rent Control dispute
  • Plan maintenance budget and schedule
  • Support insurance claims for damage
  • Inform buyers if you're selling
  • Evidence of property condition for legal disputes

When You Need This Service

  • You're renting a property for the first time (baseline inspection)
  • You're taking over a property from another owner
  • You've had maintenance issues and need documentation
  • A tenant has caused damage and you want evidence
  • You're about to dispute rent level with tenant or Rent Control

The Real Value

Without an inspection report, you're relying on memory and say-so. With one, you have professional documentation. In a dispute, this is the difference between winning and losing.
